# Ebda Store (ابدأ ستور)

Ebda Store — ابدأ ستور, by Ebda AI Studio (ebda.app). Not to be confused with any other site named Ebda: this is the Egyptian store builder at https://ebda.app, made by Ebda AI Studio.

> Ebda Store, from Ebda AI Studio — Your doorway to business. A self-serve online store builder for sellers in Egypt; a product of Ebda AI Studio (ابدأ استوديو للذكاء الاصطناعي). Arabic-first (RTL) with English. Merchants sign up, build and run their own store; every store gets a free <slug>.ebda.app address and can attach a custom domain.

Pricing (EGP per month): Basic 1,490, Growth 3,490, Business 9,990; yearly billing saves 25%; 14-day free Growth trial; 0% commission on orders on every plan. Full plan comparison (orders, team, stores, winning back abandoned carts, removing the Ebda Store badge, running the store from an AI assistant, 3D product models, analytics, support) is on the home page.

## Capabilities
- Templates, ready-made looks and a page builder
- A free address and your own domain
- AI that writes, translates and optimises (Included in the paid plans, within fair-use limits)
- Smart search that understands Egyptian Arabic and Franco
- AI search words for every product
- Search by meaning — coming soon, not live yet
- See what your shoppers search for
- SEO and visibility in AI answers
- Run your store from an AI assistant (Growth and Business plans)
- Abandoned-cart recovery (Growth and Business plans)
- Cart reminder emails (Part of abandoned-cart recovery)
- Order emails that send themselves
- Email campaigns to your subscribers (Growth and Business plans)
- Connect your store to your other tools (Growth and Business plans) — coming soon, not live yet
- Loyalty points, referral rewards and affiliates (Points on Growth and Business, affiliate programme on Business)
- Customer reviews
- Store analytics
- Multiple warehouses and purchase orders (Business plan)
- Order barcodes and a packing slip
- Wholesale selling (B2B) (Business plan) — coming soon, not live yet
- Payments and shipping the Egyptian market expects
- 0% commission on your orders

## How AI helps a merchant
- Your store gets written with you:
  - Press a button and it writes the product description in Arabic and English, and you review and publish.
  - Translate products between Arabic and English in one click.
  - Search-engine titles and descriptions, FAQs, categories, tags and image alt text, for one product or your whole store.
- Search that understands your shoppers:
  - Every product gets its own search words in Egyptian Arabic, Franco and English, and you can edit them.
  - A shopper types "gazma" or "كوتشي" and still finds the product.
  - Search by meaning: shoppers type what they have in mind and search understands what they mean. (coming soon)
- Your books close faster:
  - Snap a photo of a supplier receipt and upload it, and it becomes a draft expense for you to review.
  - Alerts when your margin drops, costs jump, revenue falls or refunds rise, explained in Arabic and English.
- Your stock tells you what to do:
  - Reorder suggestions: it works out how fast each product sells and tells you when to reorder and how much, with the reason.
  - Slow-moving products are flagged on their own, with ready-made clearance copy.
  - An email warns you when a product is about to run out.
- Your numbers explain themselves:
  - Two lines in Arabic and English above your numbers explain what changed.
  - See what shoppers searched for, and what they searched for and found nothing.
  - Products that sell together show up for shoppers on the product page and in the cart.
- Your AI assistant runs the store:
  - Ask your assistant to add products, change prices and review orders instead of opening the dashboard.
  - The InstaPay receipt a customer uploads is read automatically, so nobody types the transfer details.
  - Your store shows up for AI assistants: an llms file and a product feed they can read.

## Not there yet (stated plainly)
- Search by meaning: Coming soon: rolling out gradually, and only switched on for your store once its results pass our quality check on a real catalogue.
- Connecting other tools (webhooks): Coming soon on Growth and Business: the store will notify the tool you choose when something happens, such as a new order.
- App marketplace: There is no app marketplace.
- Custom code: You edit in the page builder without code, and there is no custom code editor.
- Wholesale (B2B) pricing: Coming soon on the Business plan: quantity price breaks, customer groups, minimum orders and wholesale-buyer approval. Until it ships there are no wholesale price lists.
- Point of sale (POS): There is no in-store point of sale.
- Multiple currencies: The store sells in Egyptian pounds only.
- Size of platform and community: A newer platform, so fewer integrations and a smaller community.
Ebda Store is a newer platform than Salla, Zid or Shopify, with fewer integrations.

<!-- capabilities:end -->

## Facts
- Store design: five templates (Qamar fashion, Souq retail, Jasmine beauty, Lamma home food, Dahab jewellery), three looks each, edited in a visual page builder (colours, photos, sections). Previews on the home page are illustrative.
- 3D: merchants upload a .glb; shoppers turn it, switch glTF colour variants and place it in their room with AR (Android Scene Viewer, iOS Quick Look). Included on every plan.
- Payments: cash on delivery, InstaPay, and card/wallet payments through Paymob, Kashier and FawryPay.
- Shipping: Bosta, ShipBlu, Mylerz and Aramex, or the merchant's own delivery.
- Also: VAT for registered merchants, a dashboard installable on the phone with order notifications, analytics, wa.me WhatsApp order buttons.
- Sign up: https://store.ebda.app/signup
- Contact: ahlan@ebda.app, WhatsApp +20 120 776 1882 (https://wa.me/201207761882); security reports: security@ebda.app
